name: Mesh Terrain Tools (Experimental)
description: Experimental, UE 5.8+ only. RQL module for Unreal's experimental Mesh Terrain (Mesh Partition): query mesh terrains, their sections and modifiers, read the surface height and rebuild with a deterministic wait.
_comment: Install-catalog metadata (one unreal-mcp-cli ExtensionDescriptor). 'version' is the .uplugin VersionName; change both with `python scripts/extension_release.py bump --plugin <Plugin> --version <x.y.z>`. 'tools' is empty: the extension adds an RQL module (docs/rql.md), not MCP tools. 'minCoreVersion' is the lowest supported Unreal-MCP core; 'minEngineVersion' the lowest Unreal Engine it builds on (the suite skips it on older engines, unreal-mcp-cli install-extension and the editor's Extensions panel refuse it); 'experimental' mirrors the .uplugin IsExperimentalVersion (shown as Experimental by the installers); 'enginePlugins' are the engine plugins the installer enables.
